description: Close your lot to all visitors (no one but roommates may enter). Prerequisite: caller must be the current lot's owner (VMTSOLotState.OwnerID == self). Effect: sets Lot_LotAdmitInfo.LotAdmitInfo_AdmitMode = 3 (ban-all) on the city DataService; fso_lots.admit_mode in the DB flips to 3. Non-roommates attempting to visit are rejected at the city allocation handler (LotAllocations.cs: admit_mode<4 && admit_mode==3 path). Cost: free — no money, no cooldown. Idempotent. Pair with `unlock-lot` to restore default public access.
call_signatures: cf $CF lock-lot                                                                      # owner-only; flips AdmitMode to 3 (ban-all)
common_mistakes: Expecting existing visitors to be kicked — lock-lot only sets AdmitMode=3 (ban non-roommates from NEW joins); current occupants stay.
perception_hints: Your own persist_id (to avoid self-targeting): perception.avatar.persist_id
Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id for Sims physically on the lot
Relationships for picking a roommate candidate: perception.relationships[]
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
target_persist_id is 0 or missing → returns ok:false with 'requires target_persist_id (> 0)'
target_persist_id == caller's own avatar_id → returns ok:false with 'cannot self-target' / 'cannot invite yourself'
